followups.message:
Khas baat: Hamari senior faculty Ms. Madhuri mam ke paas 12+ saal ka traditional Kathak repertoire aur Layakari ka deep experience hai. Unke saath Kratika Gontiya, Vibha Mittal aur Sneha Maurya jaisi certified instructors har beginner ko zero se guide karti hain. 🌟

Tatkar se lekar Chakkars tak sab kuch step-by-step sikhaya jata hai. Aap kis batch timing mein comfortable rahenge?

Sensationz Kathak ka syllabus pure classical authenticity par based hai: 📜✨
• Tatkar (Footwork & Taal mastery)
• Hastaks & Mudras (Classical hand gestures)
• Chakkars & Padhanth (Rhythmic recitation)
• Bhava & Abhinaya (Expressive storytelling)

Chahe aap beginner hon ya pehle seekh chuke hon, batch aapke level ke anusaar milega. Kaunsa time aapke schedule mein fit baithta hai? 😊

Did you know? Pehle classical Kathak seekhne ke liye dur-dur tak academy travel karna padta tha. Ab Sensationz App ke 2-way live interactive setup se aap apne ghar ke comfortable space mein authentic classical dance seekh sakte hain — bina kisi travel stress ke! 🏠💃

Kya main aapke saath packages aur timing details share karoon?

Kathak ki Taal aur Layakari dimag ko sharp banati hai aur mental focus improve karti hai. Sensationz family mein school students se lekar working women aur mothers tak sabhi shastriya sangeet aur nritya ka anand le rahe hain. 🌸

Apne andar ke classical artist ko jagane ka yeh best samay hai. Kya main aapka slot check karoon? 😊
